title: Project State Console
description: The project-state app in Claude, live from the Project State connector: every screen, the capability glances, and for editors of cloud projects the app's actions (move milestones, approve drafts, record KPIs, meetings, wiki) plus the org admin.

title: Project State Today
description: What is due this week, what is overdue, decisions waiting and drafts to review, live from the Project State connector.

title: Project State Overview
description: Phase, milestone progress, open risks and the milestone timeline, live from the Project State connector.

title: Project State Milestones
description: Milestones on a board from planned to complete, late ones flagged, live from the Project State connector.

title: Project State Calendar
description: Milestone ends, report deliverables, decision and steering-committee dates by month, live from the Project State connector.

title: Project State Risks
description: Open risks on a likelihood-by-impact grid with the app's risk intelligence, live from the Project State connector.

title: Project State Goals
description: Objectives with their KPIs, attainment and trend lines, live from the Project State connector.

title: Project State Reporting
description: Who gets which report, when, in what format and where, with the next due date for each, live from the Project State connector.

title: Project State SR&ED
description: SR&ED capture status: the filing window, the E→F→G chain, findings, the advisor handoff gates and the evidence log, live from the Project State connector.

title: Project State Research
description: The research desk: questions and how far along each is, evidence health against each mandate's gate, every mandate's life on an interactive timeline, and the graded findings register, live from the Project State connector.

title: Project State Intel
description: The intel desk and the competitive picture: entities, signals, the research agenda, claim freshness, conflicts and battlecards, live from the Project State connector.

title: Project State Queue
description: Everything leaving the project, waiting on sign-off, approved, sent or dismissed, live from the Project State connector.

title: Project State Gaps
description: The eight silent killers nobody can see, scored by the app's own logic, live from the Project State connector.

title: Project State Scoreboard
description: Whether the project keeps its five promises, measured from its own log, outbox and entities, live from the Project State connector.

title: Project State Admin
description: Org admin in Claude: add people by email, set their role, give them viewer or editor access to projects, and read the audit log, through the Project State connector.

title: Project State Runs
description: The cloud scheduler for an org's admins: what ran for each cloud project, what is queued, and the controls to run now, stop, pause and resume jobs and choose which phases the org runs, through the Project State connector.

title: Project State Harvest
description: Set up your harvest: choose which cloud projects your own mail, calendar and Slack feed, build the claude.ai routine that reads them with your connectors, and see when each project last heard from it. The cloud reads nobody's mail.

title: Project State Inputs
description: Sources and the inbox: what is waiting, accepted into working documents or deleted, live from the Project State connector.
